title: Passage Pathing
description: Count all paths through a cave system with constraints on revisiting small caves.
writeup:
## Approach

DFS path enumeration through a graph with visit constraints. Big caves (uppercase) can be revisited freely; small caves (lowercase) have visit limits.

## Part 1

Count all paths from `start` to `end` where each small cave is visited at most once. Track visited small caves in a `frozenset` as part of the DFS state.

## Part 2

Allow one small cave to be visited twice. Add a boolean flag `used_double` to the state. When encountering an already-visited small cave and the flag is unset, allow the visit and set the flag. This elegantly handles both parts in a single traversal — paths without a double visit count for both parts, paths with one count only for part 2.
